title: Rate with units
prompt: Implement `per_hour(count,seconds)`; require seconds>0 and count>=0. Example: 120 in 60 seconds gives 7200.

title: Critical-path estimate
tests:
assert periods(90,120,10)==(220,130), 'Overlapped stages contribute their maximum'
assert periods(30,10,5)==(45,35), 'Collection can also be the bottleneck'
hint: Overhead is added once in either model.

title: Policy-lag summary
prompt: Implement `lag_summary(current,versions)` returning {'max':..., 'mean':...}; reject empty lists or future versions. Example: 8,[8,7,5] has max 3 and mean 4/3.

title: Two throughput denominators
prompt: Implement `rates(row)` for fields matches, rollout_s, period_s. Return rollout_per_hour and overall_per_hour. Example: 100 matches, 50 rollout seconds, 200 total seconds gives 7200 and 1800.
tests:
r=rates({'matches':100,'rollout_s':50,'period_s':200})
assert r=={'rollout_per_hour':7200,'overall_per_hour':1800}, 'Whole-update throughput uses period_s'
r=rates({'matches':20,'rollout_s':20,'period_s':20})
assert r['rollout_per_hour']==r['overall_per_hour']==3600, 'Equal denominators give equal rates'
hint: Use the same match count but two different times.
